items.subject: Mathematics
items.title: Multiplication as repeated addition
items.learningObjective: Represent multiplication with groups of equal objects and solve simple word problems.
teacherActivities: Draw four groups of three dots.
Write 4 × 3 as repeated addition.
Explain the answer using counters.
items.studentPractice: Four baskets contain three mangoes each. How many mangoes are there? Show two methods.

items.subject: Mathematics
items.title: Fractions of a whole
items.learningObjective: Represent a fraction as equal parts and compare familiar unit fractions.
teacherActivities: Draw a rectangle and divide it into four equal parts.
Shade one quarter.
Compare one half and one quarter.
items.studentPractice: A family divides 12 oranges equally among 4 children. How many oranges does each child receive?

items.title: Simple electrical circuits
